init_RearrangeSkillPolicy: initialize a RearrangeSkillPolicy with config, observation space, action space, batch size, env, and agent uid
set_target_RearrangeSkillPolicy: set the rearrange target using a comma-separated string with object, relation, receptacle, constraint, and reference
